course.title: NIRMAAN BATCH  Class 8th
course.description:
NIRMAAN Batch is a comprehensive foundation program designed for Class 8 CBSE students to build strong conceptual clarity and excel in school as well as future exams.

Strong Foundation. Smart Learning. Complete Preparation.

*Live interactive classes (45 minutes each)
*Two live classes daily (First class – 5 PM, Second class – 7 PM)
*24×7 access to recorded lectures on App/Web
Complete coverage of New NCERT – *Science, Maths, Social Science, English (Live) l Hindi & Sanskrit (Recorded)
•⁠  ⁠Complete coverage of Old NCERT – Science, Maths, Social Science, English (Recorded)
*Dedicated English Speaking Course for fluent and confident communication
*Classroom notes
*Handwritten notes by teachers
*Complete NCERT solutions
*NCERT experiment videos for concept clarity
*Chapter-wise practice sheets
*NIRMAAN Question Bank
*Topic-wise tests
*Detailed test reports with performance analysis
*Continuous progress tracking
*Regular doubt-solving sessions
*Dedicated doubt classes after every chapter
*Test after every chapter
*Weekly study timetable for structured preparation
*PDF notes after every class (chapter-wise on App/Web)

🗓️ Batch Timeline

Batch starts: 1st week of April 2026
Syllabus completion: October End 2026
Course access valid till final exams
This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable
